findings.finding: Original thinking renderer referenced loop index i outside the map callback, causing ReferenceError when the page rendered.
findings.status: fixed in V3 and retained/further expanded in V4.

findings.finding: Original site had only 79 VOCAB objects by static object-counting, plus the later V3 expansion; several learning domains remained much smaller than the requested platform scope.
findings.status: expanded in V4 with a larger curated vocabulary library and new content layers.

findings.finding: Original SPEAK_TOPICS contained 60 topics; the requested product specification called for at least 200 practical speaking topics.
Original CONVERSATIONS contained 20 scenarios; the product specification called for at least 100 scenarios.
findings.status: expanded with additional scenario library and retained original scenarios.

findings.finding: Original LISTENING had 8 lessons and READING had 6 passages; the prototype therefore had limited long-term content depth.
findings.status: V4 adds an expansion framework while preserving originals.

findings.finding: Original WRITING had 10 tasks; more progressive writing practice is needed for long-term use.
The original section had only 5 object chains; this was too small for repeated practice.
The prototype stores learning state in localStorage and uses CDN assets; it is not yet a Laravel/MySQL multi-user production system.
findings.status: kept as a frontend prototype; documented for the next backend phase.

findings.finding: Static Node syntax checking does not replace real browser interaction testing.
findings.status: V4 includes a static audit and safer enhancement layer; browser QA remains a separate final deployment step.
